labels.label: context
labels.reason: EXPLAIN output now shows pg_temp instead of the actual temporary schema name, a cosmetic output change that needs no user action.

labels.label: noise
labels.reason: Pure bug fix correcting pg_statio_all_tables row aggregation for TOAST tables with multiple indexes, which does not change correct behavior.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Pre-existing custom variables matching an installed extension name are deleted at extension load and new ones are blocked, which can break existing configurations or sessions.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The obsolete stats_temp_directory server variable is removed, so any configuration or code setting it will fail.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: random() results for the same seed differ from prior versions, which can break reproducible tests or workloads that depend on fixed seeds.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: PQsendQuery() is no longer supported in pipeline mode, so applications using that combination must be modified to use PQsendQueryParams().

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: On non-Windows platforms HOME is now consulted first, which changes where libpq and client tools look for files such as ~/.pgpass when HOME is set.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The pg_dump --no-synchronized-snapshots option is removed, so scripts or tools passing it will fail.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: psql --single-transaction behavior changes so the final COMMIT becomes ROLLBACK only when ON_ERROR_STOP is set, altering outcomes of scripts after errors.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: postgres_fdw no longer emits unnecessary casts, which changes the generated remote queries and can alter behavior for deployments relying on the old casts.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The xml2 xml_is_well_formed() function is removed, so applications calling it must switch to the core backend version.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Custom scan providers are now assumed not to support projections by default, so existing providers that do support them must be updated.
